name: Yifan Sun
tagline: Nonlinear photonics · cavity solitons · Kerr resonators
lede: I am a Marie Skłodowska-Curie postdoctoral fellow at OPERA-Photonique, Université libre de Bruxelles, where I study how cavity solitons are born, interact and fall apart inside driven Kerr resonators.
thesis: I study how light organises itself into pulses that hold their shape for billions of round trips inside a resonator.
